primary_sources.what_it_supplies: The actual inclusion map from the continuous free product of local inertia groups into the relative arithmetic kernel is an isomorphism, and enlarging the ramification set preserves the K(pi,1) condition in the stated case.
primary_sources.hypotheses_checked: The prime is three and K=Q(zeta_3) is totally imaginary. The initial set contains the prime above three. Its K(pi,1) property and free arithmetic group are established in E.34/E.39. The cyclotomic Z_3-extension supplies nontrivial unramified completions at every added prime. Theorem2.4 supplies the same properties for the enlarged set.
primary_sources.new_argument: The two specified Frobenii form a free basis by an explicitly computed Frattini determinant. The induced inertia bundles then give inverse maps to the two local tame free-product factors and an actual conjugation-equivariant arithmetic section. The entire additive normal-form and toric-coordinate calculation is proved directly in E.56.
